1.word_for_word: ऊनाशीतितमे रामो बल्वलं द्विज-तुष्टये । — In the eighty-ninth century, Rama satisfied the Brāhmaṇas with a ball.; निहत्य तीर्य-स्नानाद्यैः सूत-हत्याम् अपानुदत् ॥ — After killing the charioteer, he avoided the killing of the charioteer by bathing on the banks of the river.; उपावृत्ते प्राप्ते ॥१-२॥ — When the upavṛte is obtained.1-2
1.translation: In the eighty-ninth century, Rama satisfied the Brāhmaṇas with a ball. After killing the charioteer, he avoided the killing of the charioteer by bathing on the banks of the river. When the upavṛte is obtained.1-2

2.word_for_word: बिह्न्नो विदीर्णो\ऽञ्जनचय उपमा यस्य तम् अतिकृष्णम् इत्य् अर्थः । — The likeness of a pile of ointment that is broken and torn means that it is very dark.; तप्त-ताम्रवच् छिखा श्मश्रूणि च यस्य तम् दंष्ट्राभिर् उग्र-भ्रुकुटी-मुखं यस्य तम् ॥३-५॥ — He whose crest and mustache were like burning copper and whose face was covered with fierce frowns with his fangs (3-5).
2.translation: The likeness of a pile of ointment that is broken and torn means that it is very dark. He whose crest and mustache were like burning copper and whose face was covered with fierce frowns with his fangs (3-5).

6.word_for_word: अरुणो रुधिरेण दैत्यः शैलो धातुभिर्यथेति ॥६-७॥ — Just as a demon is red with blood and a mountain with minerals (6-7).
6.translation: Just as a demon is red with blood and a mountain with minerals (6-7).

8.word_for_word: श्रियोधामान्यम्लानानि पङ्कजानि यस्यां ताम् ॥८॥ — That woman in whom the lotuses are sour are the abodes of the goddess of fortune.
8.translation: That woman in whom the lotuses are sour are the abodes of the goddess of fortune.

9.word_for_word: किं तत् सरः यत इति आस्रवद् उदगात् ॥९॥ — What is that lake from which it flowed?
9.translation: What is that lake from which it flowed?

10.word_for_word: अनुस्रोतेनानुलोमतः पुलहाश्रमं हरिक्षेत्रम् ॥१०॥ — Following the stream on the opposite side is the hermitage of Pulaha and the field of monkeys.
10.translation: Following the stream on the opposite side is the hermitage of Pulaha and the field of monkeys.

11.word_for_word: गोमत्याङ्गण्डक्यां विपाशायां चस्नात्वा शोणे च आप्लुतः इष्ट्वा — Having bathed in the river Gomati and the river Vipasha and immersed himself in the river Sona; सम्पूज्य ॥११-१२॥ — worshiped.11-1
11.translation: Having bathed in the river Gomati and the river Vipasha and immersed himself in the river Sona worshiped.11-1

18.word_for_word: फाल्गुनमनन्तपुरम् पञ्चाप्सरसं सरः अस्पर्शदस्पृशत् ॥१८॥ — The lake touched the city of Phalguna and the five apsaras
18.translation: The lake touched the city of Phalguna and the five apsaras

19.word_for_word: केरलादीन् देशान् ॥१९॥ — Kerala and other countries.

20.word_for_word: द्वीपमयनं यस्यास्ताम् ॥२०-२१॥ — whose island is the source of the universe.20-2
20.translation: whose island is the source of the universe.20-2

23.word_for_word: विनशनं कुरुक्षेत्रम् ॥२३॥ — Destruction of the Kurukshetra.

24.word_for_word: विवक्षुर्वक्तुम् इच्छुः किं वदिष्यतीति भिया तूष्णीमासन्न् इति ॥२४-२६॥ — They wished to discuss what he would say and remained silent for fear of what he would say (24-26).
24.translation: They wished to discuss what he would say and remained silent for fear of what he would say (24-26).

27.word_for_word: अन्यः पराजयो वा रणः सङ्गामः ॥२७॥ — Another defeat or battle is a confrontation.
27.translation: Another defeat or battle is a confrontation.

28.word_for_word: अर्थवद्वाक्यम् ॥२८॥ — It is a meaningful statement.

29.word_for_word: दिष्टं प्राचीनङ्कर्म समुपागतः सङ्गतः ॥२९॥ — It is fortunate that the ancient deeds of the ancients have come together
29.translation: It is fortunate that the ancient deeds of the ancients have come together

30.word_for_word: क्रत्वङ्गं यज्ञमूर्तिम् ॥३०॥ — The sacrificial limb is the idol of sacrifice.
30.translation: The sacrificial limb is the idol of sacrifice.

31.word_for_word: आत्मन्यधिष्ठाने विश्वगं सर्वानुस्यूतं येनैव विदुः पश्यन्ति तद्विशुद्धं विज्ञानं व्यतरददात् ॥३१-३४॥ — He imparted that pure knowledge by which they know and see the universe pervading all things pervading all things in His Self. 31-3
31.translation: He imparted that pure knowledge by which they know and see the universe pervading all things pervading all things in His Self. 31-3

34.word_for_word: इति श्रीमद्-भागवते महा-पुराणे दशम-स्कन्धे उत्तरार्धे श्रीधर-स्वामि-विरचितायां भावार्थ-दीपिकायाम् एकोनाशीतितमो\ऽध्यायः ॥७९॥ — This is the eighty-ninth chapter of the Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, the great Purāṇa, the tenth section, the second half of the Bhāva-artha-dīpika, compiled by Śrīdhara-svāmi.
34.translation: This is the eighty-ninth chapter of the Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, the great Purāṇa, the tenth section, the second half of the Bhāva-artha-dīpika, compiled by Śrīdhara-svāmi.
